annotationRationale: The method recognizes line equations, including the linear function y=x+6, and uses inequalities to restrict each line to a ray. Solving the linear inequalities supports determining the ray directions.
sourceMethod: Follows the official three-case analysis of the equal pair, explaining each ray and the shared endpoint in words.

review.mathCheck: The three equal-pair cases give \(x=1,y\le7\), \(y=7,x\le1\), and \(y=x+6,x\ge1\). These are three rays meeting only at \((1,7)\). All equalities and endpoints are included correctly, so E is correct.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithfully rephrases MAA Solution 12 on page 4. Its exhaustive cases and ray directions agree with the official figure; the explanation is reconstructible without that figure.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed graphing and ray concepts fit; solving inequalities appropriately serves as supporting knowledge.
